metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the Rust MARC 21 CLI in:

- [output/Cargo.toml](/workspace/output/Cargo.toml)
- [output/src/main.rs](/workspace/output/src/main.rs)
- [output/rules.tsv](/workspace/output/rules.tsv)

It supports ISO 2709, MARCXML, UTF-8 validation, canonical leader normalization, MARC field rules, structured errors, and required exit codes.

Verified with:

```text
cargo build --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml
```

Build succeeds with no external dependencies.
